TPM_QUOTA = 10000
REQUESTS = [(0, 4000), (10, 5000), (20, 2000), (30, 1000), (65, 8000), (70, 3000)]

class RateLimiter:
    def __init__(self, quota):
        self.quota = quota
        self.window = None
        self.used = 0

    def allow(self, ts, tokens):
        window = ts // 60
        if window != self.window:
            self.window = window
            self.used = 0
        if self.used + tokens <= self.quota:
            self.used += tokens
            return True
        return False

limiter = RateLimiter(TPM_QUOTA)
accepted = 0
rejected = 0
for ts, tokens in REQUESTS:
    if limiter.allow(ts, tokens):
        accepted += 1
        print(f"t={ts} tokens={tokens} -> 200")
    else:
        rejected += 1
        print(f"t={ts} tokens={tokens} -> 429")
print(f"accepted={accepted} rejected={rejected}")
